focusSummary: Train speed & seat classes (各駅停車, 急行, 新幹線, 自由席, 指定席), asking transfer advice with 〜に行きたいんですが, and the Rail & Station Navigation reference sheet.

lessonSteps.heading: Local vs. Express Trains: 各駅停車 & 急行
lessonSteps.explanation: Japanese tracks frequently share multiple service speeds! 各駅停車 (かくえきていしゃ, often shortened to 各停 or 普通) stops at every single station. 急行 (きゅうこう, Express) skips smaller stations—so always check if your stop is an express stop!
lessonSteps.scenarioPrompt: An express train pulls in on your track, and you want to verify whether it stops at Shimokitazawa.
lessonSteps.nativeText: すみません、この急行は下北沢に止まりますか。
lessonSteps.rubyHtml: すみません、この<ruby>急行<rt>きゅうこう</rt></ruby>は<ruby>下北沢<rt>しもきたざわ</rt></ruby>に<ruby>止<rt>と</rt></ruby>まりますか。
lessonSteps.romanization: Sumimasen, kono kyūkō wa Shimokitazawa ni tomarimasu ka.
lessonSteps.translation: Excuse me, does this express train stop at Shimokitazawa?
lessonSteps.literalBreakdown: この急行は (this express) + 下北沢に (at Shimokitazawa) + 止まりますか (does it stop?)
lessonSteps.usageTip: Note that some Limited Express trains (特急, とっきゅう) require a supplemental Limited Express ticket on top of your IC base fare.

lessonSteps.heading: Shinkansen Car Types: 自由席 vs. 指定席
lessonSteps.explanation: On the 新幹線 (しんかんせん, Bullet Train), 自由席 (じゆうせき, non-reserved cars—usually Cars 1–3) let you sit in any open seat, whereas 指定席 (していせき, reserved-seat cars) assign a specific Car (号車) and Seat (席).
lessonSteps.scenarioPrompt: You approach a Shinkansen ticket counter to buy two reserved seats to Osaka.
lessonSteps.nativeText: 新大阪まで、新幹線の指定席を二枚お願いします。
lessonSteps.rubyHtml: <ruby>新大阪<rt>しんおおさか</rt></ruby>まで、<ruby>新幹線<rt>しんかんせん</rt></ruby>の<ruby>指定席<rt>していせき</rt></ruby>を<ruby>二枚<rt>にまい</rt></ruby>お<ruby>願<rt>ねが</rt></ruby>いします。
lessonSteps.romanization: Shin-Ōsaka made, Shinkansen no shiteiseki o ni-mai onegaishimasu.
lessonSteps.translation: Two reserved-seat Shinkansen tickets to Shin-Osaka, please.
lessonSteps.literalBreakdown: 新大阪まで (up to Shin-Osaka) + 新幹線の指定席を (Shinkansen reserved seats) + 二枚 (two flat tickets) + お願いします (please)
lessonSteps.usageTip: Traveling with oversized suitcases (total dimensions > 160 cm)? Ask for 特大荷物スペースつき座席 (seats with oversized baggage space)!

lessonSteps.heading: Polite Wayfinding Opener: 〜に行きたいんですが
lessonSteps.explanation: Framing your destination with 〜に行きたいんですが ('I'd like to go to X, and [could you advise me]...') tells station staff or passersby your goal right up front so they can give you the best route or transfer.
lessonSteps.scenarioPrompt: You are standing in front of a subway map in Kyoto and want the easiest transfer to Arashiyama.
lessonSteps.nativeText: 嵐山に行きたいんですが、どこで乗り換えますか。
lessonSteps.rubyHtml: <ruby>嵐山<rt>あらしやま</rt></ruby>に<ruby>行<rt>い</rt></ruby>きたいんですが、どこで<ruby>乗<rt>の</rt></ruby>り<ruby>換<rt>か</rt></ruby>えますか。
lessonSteps.romanization: Arashiyama ni ikitai n desu ga, doko de norikaemasu ka.
lessonSteps.translation: I'd like to get to Arashiyama—where do I transfer?
lessonSteps.literalBreakdown: 嵐山に行きたい (want to go to Arashiyama) + んですが (polite explanatory opener) + どこで (at where) + 乗り換えますか (do I transfer?)
lessonSteps.usageTip: が is slightly more polished than けど; both 〜たいんですが and 〜たいんですけど work wonderfully with staff.

lessonSteps.heading: Checking Which Car to Board: 自由席は何号車ですか
lessonSteps.explanation: Shinkansen platforms stretch over 400 meters! Painted numbers on the platform floor show 号車 (ごうしゃ, Car Number) so you queue at the exact door for 自由席 or your 指定席 car.
lessonSteps.scenarioPrompt: You hold a non-reserved Shinkansen ticket on the platform and check which car numbers are non-reserved.
lessonSteps.nativeText: すみません、自由席は何号車ですか。
lessonSteps.rubyHtml: すみません、<ruby>自由席<rt>じゆうせき</rt></ruby>は<ruby>何号車<rt>なんごうしゃ</rt></ruby>ですか。
lessonSteps.romanization: Sumimasen, jiyūseki wa nan-gōsha desu ka.
lessonSteps.translation: Excuse me, which car numbers are non-reserved seating?
lessonSteps.literalBreakdown: 自由席は (as for non-reserved seats) + 何号車 (what car number) + ですか (are they?)
lessonSteps.usageTip: Typical answer: 「一号車から三号車までです」 ('Cars 1 through 3'). Note that peak holiday Nozomi trains sometimes operate as all-reserved!

drills.prompt: Your destination is a small neighborhood station that express trains skip. Which train type stops at EVERY station?
drills.explanation: 各駅停車 (kakueki teisha, literally 'each-station stopping train') stops at every station along the line.

drills.prompt: You want to ask a station attendant where to transfer in order to get to Nara (奈良). Complete the polite framing:
drills.baseSentence: 奈良に＿＿＿、どこで乗り換えますか。
drills.explanation: Destination + に行きたいんですが states your travel goal politely and invites clear routing advice.

drills.prompt: You want guaranteed seats together by the window on the Shinkansen rather than queuing for unreserved cars. Which seat type do you ask for?
drills.explanation: 指定席 (shiteiseki) assigns a specific car and seat number, whereas 自由席 (jiyūseki) is unreserved first-come, first-served seating.

gradedStories.title: 新幹線から各駅停車への乗り換え
gradedStories.titleTranslation: Transferring from the Shinkansen to a Local Train
gradedStories.setting: Mid-morning arrival at Kyoto Station, transferring to reach a quieter neighborhood shrine.

paragraphs.nativeText: 新幹線の指定席に乗って、東京から京都駅に着きました。車内はとても静かで、富士山もきれいに見えました。
paragraphs.rubyHtml: <ruby>新幹線<rt>しんかんせん</rt></ruby>の<ruby>指定席<rt>していせき</rt></ruby>に<ruby>乗<rt>の</rt></ruby>って、<ruby>東京<rt>とうきょう</rt></ruby>から<ruby>京都駅<rt>きょうとえき</rt></ruby>に<ruby>着<rt>つ</rt></ruby>きました。<ruby>車内<rt>しゃない</rt></ruby>はとても<ruby>静<rt>しず</rt></ruby>かで、<ruby>富士山<rt>ふじさん</rt></ruby>もきれいに<ruby>見<rt>み</rt></ruby>えました。
paragraphs.translation: Riding in a reserved seat on the Shinkansen, I arrived at Kyoto Station from Tokyo. Inside the car it was very quiet, and Mount Fuji was clearly visible too.

paragraphs.nativeText: 乗り換え改札の前で、駅員さんに「伏見稲荷に行きたいんですが、どの線ですか」と聞きました。駅員さんは「奈良線の各駅停車に乗ってください。急行は止まりませんよ」と教えてくれました。
paragraphs.rubyHtml: <ruby>乗<rt>の</rt></ruby>り<ruby>換<rt>か</rt></ruby>え<ruby>改札<rt>かいさつ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>前<rt>まえ</rt></ruby>で、<ruby>駅員<rt>えきいん</rt></ruby>さんに「<ruby>伏見稲荷<rt>ふしみいなり</rt></ruby>に<ruby>行<rt>い</rt></ruby>きたいんですが、どの<ruby>線<rt>せん</rt></ruby>ですか」と<ruby>聞<rt>き</rt></ruby>きました。<ruby>駅員<rt>えきいん</rt></ruby>さんは「<ruby>奈良線<rt>ならせん</rt></ruby>の<ruby>各駅停車<rt>かくえきていしゃ</rt></ruby>に<ruby>乗<rt>の</rt></ruby>ってください。<ruby>急行<rt>きゅうこう</rt></ruby>は<ruby>止<rt>と</rt></ruby>まりませんよ」と<ruby>教<rt>おし</rt></ruby>えてくれました。
paragraphs.translation: In front of the transfer gates, I asked an attendant, 'I'd like to go to Fushimi Inari—which line is it?' The attendant told me, 'Please take a local train on the Nara Line. Express trains don't stop there!'

segments.rubyHtml: <ruby>乗<rt>の</rt></ruby>り<ruby>換<rt>か</rt></ruby>え<ruby>改札<rt>かいさつ</rt></ruby>
<ruby>各駅停車<rt>かくえきていしゃ</rt></ruby>

paragraphs.nativeText: ホームの案内を見て、「普通」と書いてある電車に乗りました。五分で稲荷駅に着いて、赤い鳥居がすぐ目の前にありました。
paragraphs.rubyHtml: ホームの<ruby>案内<rt>あんない</rt></ruby>を<ruby>見<rt>み</rt></ruby>て、「<ruby>普通<rt>ふつう</rt></ruby>」と<ruby>書<rt>か</rt></ruby>いてある<ruby>電車<rt>でんしゃ</rt></ruby>に<ruby>乗<rt>の</rt></ruby>りました。<ruby>五分<rt>ごふん</rt></ruby>で<ruby>稲荷駅<rt>いなりえき</rt></ruby>に<ruby>着<rt>つ</rt></ruby>いて、<ruby>赤<rt>あか</rt></ruby>い<ruby>鳥居<rt>とりい</rt></ruby>がすぐ<ruby>目<rt>め</rt></ruby>の<ruby>前<rt>まえ</rt></ruby>にありました。
paragraphs.translation: Checking the platform display, I boarded the train marked 'Local (普通)'. In five minutes I arrived at Inari Station, and the vermilion torii gates stood right before my eyes.

segments.meaning: local train (synonym of 各駅停車)
right in front of one's eyes

questions.question: Which seat class did the traveler ride on the Shinkansen from Tokyo to Kyoto?
questions.explanation: The story begins with 「新幹線の指定席に乗って」 ('Riding in a reserved seat on the Shinkansen').

questions.question: Why did the attendant warn the traveler NOT to take an express (急行) train?
options: Express trains only run after midnight
Express trains do not accept tickets
The Nara Line was closed for construction
Express trains skip Inari Station—only local trains stop there
questions.explanation: The attendant advised taking 各駅停車 (or 普通) because 「急行は止まりませんよ」 ('Express trains don't stop there').

questions.question: What word appeared on the platform display as an everyday equivalent for 各駅停車?
questions.explanation: In western Japan (JR West / Kansai) especially, local all-stop trains are labeled 普通 (futsū).

referenceSheets.title: Rail & Station Navigation
referenceSheets.subtitle: Train speeds, Shinkansen seating, IC gates, and station counters decoded

rows.rubyHtml: <ruby>各駅停車<rt>かくえきていしゃ</rt></ruby> / <ruby>普通<rt>ふつう</rt></ruby>
rows.readingOrSubtle: Kakueki-teisha / Futsū (often shortened to 各停)
rows.meaning: Local train — stops at every single station
rows.exampleNative: 各駅停車で三つ目の駅です。
rows.exampleTranslation: It's the third stop on the local train.
rows.notes: Covered by your base fare / IC card tap.

rows.rubyHtml: <ruby>快速<rt>かいそく</rt></ruby> / <ruby>急行<rt>きゅうこう</rt></ruby>
rows.meaning: Skips smaller local stations at no extra surcharge on most commuter lines
rows.exampleNative: この急行は新宿に止まりますか。
rows.exampleTranslation: Does this express stop at Shinjuku?
rows.notes: Contrast with 特急 (Tokkyū, Limited Express), which usually requires an extra 特急券 seat/express surcharge.

rows.term: 自由席 vs. 指定席
rows.rubyHtml: <ruby>自由席<rt>じゆうせき</rt></ruby> vs. <ruby>指定席<rt>していせき</rt></ruby>
rows.meaning: Non-reserved open seating vs. Reserved assigned car & seat
rows.exampleNative: 三号車は自由席です。五号車は指定席です。
rows.exampleTranslation: Car 3 is non-reserved. Car 5 is reserved seating.
rows.notes: グリーン車 (Green Car) is spacious first-class reserved seating marked with a four-leaf clover symbol.

rows.rubyHtml: <ruby>乗<rt>の</rt></ruby>り<ruby>換<rt>か</rt></ruby>え<ruby>改札<rt>かいさつ</rt></ruby>
rows.meaning: Dedicated transfer gate (e.g., between Shinkansen and local JR lines)
rows.exampleNative: 新幹線の乗り換え改札を通ります。
rows.exampleTranslation: Pass through the Shinkansen transfer gate.
rows.notes: Insert paper Shinkansen ticket(s) together—and remember to retrieve them on the far side if continuing!

rows.rubyHtml: のりこし<ruby>精算機<rt>せいさんき</rt></ruby>
rows.meaning: Fare adjustment machine inside the ticket gates
rows.exampleNative: 残高が足りないので、精算機でチャージします。
rows.exampleTranslation: Since my balance is short, I top up at the fare adjustment machine.
rows.notes: Settles short IC balances or extended rides BEFORE you walk through the exit gate.

rows.rubyHtml: みどりの<ruby>窓口<rt>まどぐち</rt></ruby>
rows.meaning: Staffed JR rail counter for Shinkansen bookings, rail passes, and seat changes
rows.exampleNative: みどりの窓口で指定席を変更します。
rows.exampleTranslation: Change a reserved seat at the JR Ticket Office.
rows.notes: Look for the green reclining-seat icon at major JR stations.
